company.name: Shout
company.shortDescription: Shout is a place where any passionate group can build their own marketplace. We call them streams and each stream is led by a moderator.
company.description:
Shout is a one-to-one exchange platform that enables its users to post classifieds to sell tickets and reservations.


It also has developed an iOS application that enables its users to communicate in real time with the sellers and handle payments online.
